> 本仓库基于 [PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer](https://github.com/PandaAIDD/dsh-molecule-viewer)（MIT 许可）改写，独立演进。

> 包名是 **`dsh-molecule-visualization`**（上游叫 `dsh-molecule-viewer`；工具名仍是 `view_molecule`）。
> **改动清单**见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)（逐项）与 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)；上游版权声明与 MIT 许可完整保留，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 相对上游 0.2.0 修复的问题：| # | 问题 | 上游症状 | 本仓库的处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mol` 格式被静默丢弃 | 工具声明支持 `mol`，但格式被原样传给 `addModel`。3Dmol.js 2.4.2 **没有** `mol` 解析器，会打印 `Unknown format: mol` 并按文本猜格式；真实 molfile 多数会被猜成 `xyz` → **解析出 0 个原子、外框正常、分子不显示、无报错**（实测 14 个真实 `.mol` 里 12 个渲染 0 原子） | 输入 `mol` 内部映射为 `sdf` 解析器；载荷里带 `renderFormat` 字段，客户端也会兜底映射（旧会话记录同样能修好） |
| 2 | 失败对用户不可见 | 解析失败/空模型只留下空白 canvas | 卡片上显示**具体原因 + 修复建议 + 重试按钮**：解析异常、0 原子、WebGL 不可用、容器不可见各有独立文案；渲染后还会核对「host 统计原子数 vs 3Dmol 实际载入数」 |
| 3 | 缺少球棍样式 | 只有 stick/line/sphere/cartoon | 新增 `ballstick`：`{ stick: { radius: 0.15 }, sphere: { scale: 0.25 } }` 两种表示叠加（3Dmol 没有原生球棍表示） |
| 4 | 无键模型什么都画不出来 | stick 靠键绘制；无键表（XYZ、空 bond 块）→ 空画面 | 载入后若键数为 0，先 `model.assignBonds()` 按距离推断；仍为 0 则降级为球状显示并在卡片上说明（不会空白） |
| 5 | 布局等待可能永久挂起 | `awaitLayoutBox()` 等待非零尺寸，祖先被折叠/隐藏时永不 resolve → 永远 "Loading 3D viewer…" | 加 10 秒超时，超时后显示「容器不可见」+ 原因（`display:none` / 0×0）+ 重试按钮 |
| 6 | 格式校验太松 | PDB 固定列错位仍被接受，3Dmol.js 静默丢原子（实测一份 Chem3D 导出的 PDB：host 数到 92 个原子，画面只有 1 个） | host 侧按 PDB 规范逐列校验（记录名 1-6、x 31-38、y 39-46、z 47-54、resName 18-20、第 30 列必须为空）；识别「整份文件统一 altLoc」这一列错位特征并**修复列 17**（修复会以警告写进卡片），也可用 `repairShiftedPdbAltLoc: false` 关闭改为直接报错 |

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 特性：- 🧬 **六种格式**：PDB、SDF、MOL、MOL2、XYZ，以及 Gaussian 输入（`.gjf` / `.com`，只取几何结构）
- 🧱 **PDB 列校验 + 自动修复**：错位/截断/非数字坐标直接给出「哪一行、哪一列」；整份文件统一的 altLoc 伪标记会被修复并提示
- 📁 **路径优先**：直接传文件路径，服务端读取——Windows（`D:\dir\x.pdb`）、WSL（`/mnt/d/dir/x.pdb`）与 `~/` 自动互转
- 🖱️ **交互式查看器**：旋转、缩放，实时切换 **ball & stick** / stick / line / sphere / cartoon，背景色与分子着色
- 🔄 **重启可恢复**：载荷随 `tool/result` 事件持久化（`presentationMeta`），重启后照常渲染，无需自定义事件类型
- ⚠️ **失败可见**：空白 canvas 不再可能——每类失败都有具体原因、建议与重试
- ⏱️ **超时保护**：容器不可见时 10 秒后给出提示，而不是永久 Loading
- ⤢ **可放大到整个窗口**：卡片内是紧凑视图（高度随窗口自适应，不再写死 400px），点右上角「放大」用浮层铺满窗口，Esc 或点遮罩收起
- 📦 **本地打包 3Dmol.js**：`vendor/3Dmol-min.cjs`（2.4.2）构建时打进 client bundle——无 CDN 运行时请求，可离线
- 🔍 **可验证**：`node scripts/verify.mjs` 一条命令跑完类型检查、98 个测试（含 3 个 jsdom 渲染测试）、
  3Dmol 解析探针、真实文件端到端探针与构建产物冒烟测试

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 支持的格式：| 格式 | 扩展名 | 渲染用解析器 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| PDB | `.pdb` `.ent` | `pdb` | 蛋白质/大分子（ATOM/HETATM 记录）；`keepH` 保证氢原子不被丢弃 |
| SDF | `.sdf` `.sd` | `sdf` | 多分子结构（V2000/V3000）；多分子文件只渲染第一条并提示 |
| MOL | `.mol` | **`sdf`** | MDL MOL（V2000/V3000）——3Dmol.js 没有 `mol` 解析器 |
| MOL2 | `.mol2` | `mol2` | TRIPOS 格式 |
| XYZ | `.xyz` | `xyz` | 无键表，载入后按距离感知成键 |
| GJF | `.gjf` `.com` | **`xyz`** | Gaussian 输入文件，host 侧把几何块转成 XYZ（忽略路由段/Link1/ECP） |

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 支持的格式：> SMILES 不支持——必须有 3D 坐标（与上游一致）。
>
> 超过 2 MB 的分子内容不会内联进会话日志，查看器位置显示摘要卡片（原子数与格式仍可见）。

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 渲染样式：| 样式 | 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `ballstick` | 球棍 | 细棒 + 小球叠加（`stick.radius 0.15`、`sphere.scale 0.25`）——小分子推荐；默认仍是 `stick` |
| `stick` | 棒状 | 只有化学键 |
| `line` | 线框 | 最轻 |
| `sphere` | 空间填充 | 范德华半径 |
| `cartoon` | 飘带 | 蛋白二级结构；配体/小分子自动改用棒状以免看不见 |

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 工具参数：| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | 与 `data` 二选一（**优先**） | 分子文件路径，按你的原始写法传入（Windows/WSL 双向兼容，`~/` 自动展开） |
| `data` | `string` | 与 `path` 二选一 | 分子文件纯文本内容——仅用于磁盘上没有文件的情况，不要 base64 |
| `format` | `pdb \| sdf \| mol2 \| mol \| xyz \| gjf` | 传 `data` 时必填 | 传 `path` 时按扩展名推断，可省略 |
| `name` | `string` | 否 | 显示名称，作为查看器标题 |
| `style` | `stick \| ballstick \| line \| sphere \| cartoon` | 否 | 初始样式（默认 `stick`；蛋白质建议 `cartoon`） |

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 卡片上会看到什么：| 情况 | 卡片表现 |
|---|---|
| 正常 | 3D 视图 + 样式/背景/着色控件；有警告时底部显示 ⚠ 提示条 |
| host 校验失败（列错位、截断、格式不符） | 红色标题「无法显示这份 PDB 结构（文件名）：具体原因」+ 修复建议 + 校验警告 |
| 3Dmol.js 解析出 0 原子 | 「3Dmol.js 没有读出原子：…（host 侧统计到 N 个）」+ 建议 |
| host / 渲染原子数不符 | 视图照常渲染 + 提示「只载入了 45/92 个原子」 |
| 容器被折叠/隐藏 | 10 秒后「容器不可见，渲染超时：原因」+ 重试 |
| WebGL 不可用 | 「WebGL 不可用：…」+ 建议检查浏览器 GPU 设置 |
| 想细看 / 卡片太矮 | 点右上角「⤢ 放大」：浮层里用整个窗口渲染，Esc 或点遮罩关闭；会话里留一行「收起放大视图」的入口 |

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Fixes over upstream 0.2.0：| # | Bug | Upstream symptom | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mol` silently dropped | The declared format went straight to `addModel`. 3Dmol.js 2.4.2 has **no `mol` parser**: it logs `Unknown format: mol`, guesses, and for most real molfiles guesses `xyz` → **0 atoms, empty frame, no error** (measured: 12 of 14 real `.mol` files) | `mol` maps to the `sdf` parser; the payload carries `renderFormat`, and the client maps it again so replayed old sessions also render |
| 2 | Failures invisible | Blank canvas, nothing said | The card shows the specific reason, an actionable hint and a Retry button (parse error / zero atoms / no WebGL / container never laid out); after loading, the host's atom count is reconciled against what 3Dmol.js actually loaded |
| 3 | No ball-and-stick | Only stick/line/sphere/cartoon | New `ballstick`: `{ stick: { radius: 0.15 }, sphere: { scale: 0.25 } }` overlaid on one selection (3Dmol.js has no native representation) |
| 4 | Bond-less models render nothing | Stick styles draw bonds; no bond table (XYZ, empty bond block) → empty view | On load, if the bond count is 0 the viewer calls `model.assignBo

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Fixes over upstream 0.2.0：Measured details, including what did **not** reproduce, are in [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md).
Short version: bugs 1, 2, 5 and 6 reproduce; 3 is a confirmed missing feature; **bug 4 as described does not
hold on 2.4.2** — 3Dmol.js already perceives bonds for PDB files without CONECT (1CRN with its CONECT
records stripped still yields 334 bonds). This repository keeps the perceive-then-fallback path anyway, as defense
in depth.

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Features：- 🧬 Six formats: PDB, SDF, MOL, MOL2, XYZ, and Gaussian input (`.gjf`/`.com`, geometry only)
- 🧱 PDB column validation with repair, naming the exact line and column
- 📁 Path-first: Windows, WSL and `~/` spellings resolve automatically
- 🖱️ Ball & stick / stick / line / sphere / cartoon, background and color modes
- 🔄 Durable: the payload rides `tool/result`'s `presentationMeta` and replays after restarts
- ⚠️ Every failure is visible, with a reason, a hint and Retry
- ⏱️ No infinite loading
- ⤢ Expand to the full window: the inline card is compact with a responsive height (no fixed 400px); the expand button lifts the viewer into a window-sized overlay (Esc or a backdrop click closes it)
- 📦 3Dmol.js 2.4.2 vendored into the client bundle — no CDN, works offline
- 🔍 Verifiable: `node scripts/verify.mjs` runs typecheck, 98 tests (3 of them render the built bundle in
  jsdom), a 3Dmol parse probe, a real-file end-to-end probe and a built-artifact smoke test

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Formats：| Format | Extension | Parser | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| PDB | `.pdb` `.ent` | `pdb` | Loaded with `keepH: true` so explicit hydrogens survive |
| SDF | `.sdf` `.sd` | `sdf` | V2000/V3000; multi-molecule files render the first record (noted on the card) |
| MOL | `.mol` | **`sdf`** | 3Dmol.js has no `mol` parser |
| MOL2 | `.mol2` | `mol2` | TRIPOS |
| XYZ | `.xyz` | `xyz` | No bond table; bonds perceived by distance |
| GJF | `.gjf` `.com` | **`xyz`** | Geometry block converted host-side |
dsh-molecule-visualization README · Formats：SMILES is not supported (out of scope, and there are no 3D coordinates).

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Styles：`stick` (default), `ballstick` (balls + sticks, recommended for small molecules), `line`,
`sphere` (space-filling), `cartoon`
(protein ribbons; ligands automatically fall back to sticks).

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Tool parameters：| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | one of `path`/`data` (**preferred**) | File path in any host dialect |

dsh-molecule-visualization README · 相对上游 0.2.0 修复的问题：| # | 问题 | 上游症状 | 本仓库的处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mol` 格式被静默丢弃 | 工具声明支持 `mol`，但格式被原样传给 `addModel`。3Dmol.js 2.4.2 **没有** `mol` 解析器，会打印 `Unknown format: mol` 并按文本猜格式；真实 molfile 多数会被猜成 `xyz` → **解析出 0 个原子、外框正常、分子不显示、无报错**（实测 14 个真实 `.mol` 里 12 个渲染 0 原子） | 输入 `mol` 内部映射为 `sdf` 解析器；载荷里带 `renderFormat` 字段，客户端也会兜底映射（旧会话记录同样能修好） |
| 2 | 失败对用户不可见 | 解析失败/空模型只留下空白 canvas | 卡片上显示**具体原因 + 修复建议 + 重试按钮**：解析异常、0 原子、WebGL 不可用、容器不可见各有独立文案；渲染后还会核对「host 统计原子数 vs 3Dmol 实际载入数」 |
| 3 | 缺少球棍样式 | 只有 stick/line/sphere/cartoon | 新增 `ballstick`：`{ stick: { radius: 0.15 }, sphere: { scale: 0.25 } }` 两种表示叠加（3Dmol 没有原生球棍表示） |
| 4 | 无键模型什么都画不出来 | stick 靠键绘制；无键表（XYZ、空 bond 块）→ 空画面 | 载入后若键数为 0，先 `model.assignBonds()` 按距离推断；仍为 0 则降级为球状显示并在卡片上说明（不会空白） |
| 5 | 布局等待可能永久挂起 | `awaitLayoutBox()` 等待非零尺寸，祖先被折叠/隐藏时永不 resolve → 永远 "Loading 3D viewer…" | 加 10 秒超时，超时后显示「容器不可见」+ 原因（`display:none` / 0×0）+ 重试按钮 |
| 6 | 格式校验太松 | PDB 固定列错位仍被接受，3Dmol.js 静默丢原子（实测一份 Chem3D 导出的 PDB：host 数到 92 个原子，画面只有 1 个） | host 侧按 PDB 规范逐列校验（记录名 1-6、x 31-38、y 39-46、z 47-54、resName 18-20、第 30 列必须为空）；识别「整份文件统一 altLoc」这一列错位特征并**修复列 17**（修复会以警告写进卡片），也可用 `repairShiftedPdbAltLoc: false` 关闭改为直接报错 |

- 🧱 **PDB 列校验 + 自动修复**：错位/截断/非数字坐标直接给出「哪一行、哪一列」；整份文件统一的 altLoc 伪标记会被修复并提示

- ⏱️ **超时保护**：容器不可见时 10 秒后给出提示，而不是永久 Loading

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Fixes over upstream 0.2.0：| # | Bug | Upstream symptom | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mol` silently dropped | The declared format went straight to `addModel`. 3Dmol.js 2.4.2 has **no `mol` parser**: it logs `Unknown format: mol`, guesses, and for most real molfiles guesses `xyz` → **0 atoms, empty frame, no error** (measured: 12 of 14 real `.mol` files) | `mol` maps to the `sdf` parser; the payload carries `renderFormat`, and the client maps it again so replayed old sessions also render |
| 2 | Failures invisible | Blank canvas, nothing said | The card shows the specific reason, an actionable hint and a Retry button (parse error / zero atoms / no WebGL / container never laid out); after loading, the host's atom count is reconciled against what 3Dmol.js actually loaded |
| 3 | No ball-and-stick | Only stick/line/sphere/cartoon | New `ballstick`: `{ stick: { radius: 0.15 }, sphere: { scale: 0.25 } }` overlaid on one selection (3Dmol.js has no native representation) |
| 4 | Bond-less models render nothing | Stick styles draw bonds; no bond table (XYZ, empty bond block) → empty view | On load, if the bond count is 0 the viewer calls `model.assignBo

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Fixes over upstream 0.2.0：Measured details, including what did **not** reproduce, are in [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md).
Short version: bugs 1, 2, 5 and 6 reproduce; 3 is a confirmed missing feature; **bug 4 as described does not
hold on 2.4.2** — 3Dmol.js already perceives bonds for PDB files without CONECT (1CRN with its CONECT
records stripped still yields 334 bonds). This repository keeps the perceive-then-fallback path anyway, as defense
in depth.

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Features：- 🧬 Six formats: PDB, SDF, MOL, MOL2, XYZ, and Gaussian input (`.gjf`/`.com`, geometry only)
- 🧱 PDB column validation with repair, naming the exact line and column
- 📁 Path-first: Windows, WSL and `~/` spellings resolve automatically
- 🖱️ Ball & stick / stick / line / sphere / cartoon, background and color modes
- 🔄 Durable: the payload rides `tool/result`'s `presentationMeta` and replays after restarts
- ⚠️ Every failure is visible, with a reason, a hint and Retry
- ⏱️ No infinite loading
- ⤢ Expand to the full window: the inline card is compact with a responsive height (no fixed 400px); the expand button lifts the viewer into a window-sized overlay (Esc or a backdrop click closes it)
- 📦 3Dmol.js 2.4.2 vendored into the client bundle — no CDN, works offline
- 🔍 Verifiable: `node scripts/verify.mjs` runs typecheck, 98 tests (3 of them render the built bundle in
  jsdom), a 3Dmol parse probe, a real-file end-to-end probe and a built-artifact smoke test

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Install：The client half hot-reloads (DSH's `client-hmr` polls the bundle every 500 ms), so a page refresh is
enough for renderer changes. Host-half changes (tool registration, format enum, validation) need a
DSH restart: `dsh --profile web`.

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Formats：| Format | Extension | Parser | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| PDB | `.pdb` `.ent` | `pdb` | Loaded with `keepH: true` so explicit hydrogens survive |
| SDF | `.sdf` `.sd` | `sdf` | V2000/V3000; multi-molecule files render the first record (noted on the card) |
| MOL | `.mol` | **`sdf`** | 3Dmol.js has no `mol` parser |
| MOL2 | `.mol2` | `mol2` | TRIPOS |
| XYZ | `.xyz` | `xyz` | No bond table; bonds perceived by distance |
| GJF | `.gjf` `.com` | **`xyz`** | Geometry block converted host-side |
dsh-molecule-visualization README · Formats：SMILES is not supported (out of scope, and there are no 3D coordinates).

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Styles：`stick` (default), `ballstick` (balls + sticks, recommended for small molecules), `line`,
`sphere` (space-filling), `cartoon`
(protein ribbons; ligands automatically fall back to sticks).

dsh-molecule-visualization README · Tool parameters：| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | one of `path`/`data` (**preferred**) | File path in any host dialect |
| `data` | `string` | one of `path`/`data` | Raw content, only when no file exists |
| `format` | `pdb \| sdf \| mol2 \| mol \| xyz \| gjf` | with `data` | Inferred from the extension with `path` |
| `name` | `string` | no | Viewer title |
| `style` | `stick \| ballstick \| line \| sphere \| cartoon` | no | Initial style |
